in_sanskrit.name: Tr
in_sanskrit.meaning: हिन्दू नाम जिसका अर्थ है River
in_sanskrit.long_meaning: Tr एक संस्कृत नाम है जो हिंदू संस्कृति में गहरा आध्यात्मिक महत्व रखता है। Derived from the Sanskrit word ‘tranasa’ meaning ‘to cross’ or ‘to move over’, this name signifies a river or a body of water. In Hindu mythology, rivers are believed to be sacred and have a purifying and nurturing influence on all life.
